items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: Even the Doc Severson band playing guitar bass now.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I noticed that it does change the line.

And I played string bass 37 years. And this has frets on it, and the string bass doesn't have frets. So, you know, and being an old guitar player for four years, it came to me quicker than I anticipated. So I really like it. I can truthfully say I really like guitar, bass. I know a lot of the old timers like the string bass now. And I don't dislike string bass. I still love string bass, and I love to hear good bass players. I'm not putting down string bass at all because I played it for 37 years, and I really…
Do you ever use the fuzz tone and those effects? Anything like that?
